Duration until you drop it or it is broken

Establish one false identity with credentials to match, chosen when you take this feat and changeable during downtime. While maintaining it you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Impersonate, and a creature that succeeds at seeing through the disguise must succeed again the next time it interacts with you before it is certain — the paperwork holds up even when the face does not.
